title: Simple Light Beam Wave Visualization
full_prompt:
Write a complete ManimGL script that visualizes a propagating 3D electromagnetic wave (light beam). The visualization must include:
1. A 3D coordinate system with axes and a background grid plane aligned with the axes.
2. A custom `OscillatingWave` class (inheriting from `VMobject`) that represents a 3D sinusoidal wave propagating along the x-axis. The wave should support independent y and z amplitudes, phases, and a twist rate (polarization rotation) along the propagation direction. It must update dynamically over time using an updater function.
3. A custom `GraphAsVectorField` class (inheriting from `VectorField`) that displays electric field vectors pointing from the propagation axis (x-axis) to the wave's position at discrete intervals.
4. A scene class `SimpleLightBeam` that sets up the 3D camera, instantiates the axes, plane, oscillating wave with a spectral color gradient, and the corresponding vector field, and animates the propagation of the light wave.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Incorrect 3D coordinate mapping using c2p inside updaters
common_failure_modes.note: Ensure the wave points are correctly transformed from the mathematical coordinate space to the visual 3D space using axes.c2p.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Missing or broken time-dependent update loop
common_failure_modes.note: The wave must continuously update its points based on dt to simulate propagation. If the clock is stopped or updater is not added, the wave remains static.
Using colormaps.get_cmap('Spectral') requires proper integration with matplotlib or ManimGL's internal color utilities.
